summary: The driver reads gate-verdict/v2 and halts with exit 2 on any check-gap finding (all findings printed, nothing sent back, no work, no commit, no plan left); uncovered and other kinds are still sent back. Committed end-to-end tests now cover the halt and the sent-back path.
verified: vloop task gate T2 exited 0 and printed gate T2: ok; go test ./cmd/vloop -run TestRunGateReview passes; gofmt -l . empty.
notes: New tests in cmd/vloop/run_gatereview_test.go: TestRunGateReviewCheckGapHalts (round 1 alone, round 1 beside wrong-reason, round 2 after a sent-back finding; each then re-runs and plans afresh) and TestRunGateReviewUncoveredIsSentBack. cmd/vloop stub verdicts were moved from gate-verdict/v1 to v2 because the driver now reads v2 only.
